title: Gunmen
wikitext:
Gunmen of the Apocalypse were a British QW clan formed in 1998 by a group of friends living in the St Annes/Blackpool area. They were short-lived and never played in any tournaments but were notable for eventually evolving into Quake3 clan 'Hellborn'. Several of their members went on to join [[tgc]].
